import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra

using JSON3

function initstacks_coarsen_retire_b(levels, n)
    cur = n
    prefix_t_stack_1 = Vector{Int}(undef, div(levels - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_t_stack_1 = 0
    prefix_tripcount_stack_1 = Vector{Int}(undef, div(levels - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = 0
    val_cur_1 = Vector{Int64}(undef, div(levels - 1, 1) + 1)
    for i_l = 1:levels
        prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] = __tot_t_stack_1
        prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] = __tot_tripcount_stack_1
        val_cur_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] = cur
        __tot_t_stack_1 = __tot_t_stack_1 + ((div(cur - 1, 1) + 1) + 1)
        __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = __tot_tripcount_stack_1 + 1
        cur = div(cur + 1, 2)
    end
    tripcount_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    t_stack = Vector{Float64}(undef, __tot_t_stack_1 + 1)
    return (tripcount_stack, t_stack, prefix_t_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_t_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_cur_1)
end

function coarsen_retire_b(x, xb, y, yb, n, levels, out, outb, tripcount_stack, t_stack, prefix_t_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_t_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_cur_1)
    t = 0.0
    tb = 0.0
    cur = n
    for i_l = 1:levels
        __idx_tripcount_stack_1_0 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + 1
        tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_0] = cur
        for i = 1:cur
            __idx_t_stack_1_0 = prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + ((i - 1) + 1)
            t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_0] = t
            t = x[i] * x[i]
            y[i] = y[i] + t * t
        end
        cur = div(cur + 1, 2)
        __idx_t_stack_1_4 = (prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + (div(val_cur_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
        t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_4] = t
    end
    out[1] = y[1]
    t_stack[__tot_t_stack_1 + 1] = t
    t = t_stack[__tot_t_stack_1 + 1]
    yb[1] = yb[1] + outb[1]
    outb[1] = 0.0
    for i_l = levels:-1:1
        __idx_t_stack_1_0 = (prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + (div(val_cur_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
        t = t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_0]
        __idx_tripcount_stack_1_2 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + 1
        cur = tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_2]
        for i = cur:-1:1
            tb = tb + t * yb[i]
            tb = tb + t * yb[i]
            __idx_t_stack_1_0 = prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + ((i - 1) + 1)
            t = t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_0]
            xb[i] = xb[i] + x[i] * tb
            xb[i] = xb[i] + x[i] * tb
            tb = 0.0
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_coarsen_retire_b_cuda(levels, n)
    cur = n
    prefix_t_stack_1 = CuArray{Int}(undef, div(levels - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_t_stack_1 = 0
    prefix_tripcount_stack_1 = CuArray{Int}(undef, div(levels - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = 0
    val_cur_1 = CuArray{Int64}(undef, div(levels - 1, 1) + 1)
    for i_l = 1:levels
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] = __tot_t_stack_1
                prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] = __tot_tripcount_stack_1
                val_cur_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] = cur
                __tot_t_stack_1 = __tot_t_stack_1 + ((div(cur - 1, 1) + 1) + 1)
                __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = __tot_tripcount_stack_1 + 1
                cur = div(cur + 1, 2)
            end
    end
    tripcount_stack = CuArray{Int64}(undef, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    t_stack = CuArray{Float64}(undef, __tot_t_stack_1 + 1)
    return (tripcount_stack, t_stack, prefix_t_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_t_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_cur_1)
end

function coarsen_retire_b_cuda(x, xb, y, yb, n, levels, out, outb, tripcount_stack, t_stack, prefix_t_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_t_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_cur_1)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    t = 0.0
    tb = 0.0
    cur = n
    for i_l = 1:levels
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                __idx_tripcount_stack_1_0 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + 1
                tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_0] = cur
            end
        for i = 1:cur
            CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                    __idx_t_stack_1_0 = prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + ((i - 1) + 1)
                    t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_0] = t
                    t = x[i] * x[i]
                    y[i] = y[i] + t * t
                end
        end
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                cur = div(cur + 1, 2)
                __idx_t_stack_1_4 = (prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + (div(val_cur_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
                t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_4] = t
            end
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            out[1] = y[1]
            t_stack[__tot_t_stack_1 + 1] = t
            t = t_stack[__tot_t_stack_1 + 1]
            yb[1] = yb[1] + outb[1]
            outb[1] = 0.0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - levels, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_coarsen_retire_b_1!(levels, prefix_t_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, t_stack, tripcount_stack, val_cur_1, x, xb, yb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_coarsen_retire_b_1!(levels, prefix_t_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, t_stack, tripcount_stack, val_cur_1, x, xb, yb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - levels, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_l = levels + (__tid - 1) * -1
    tb = 0.0
    __idx_t_stack_1_0 = (prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + (div(val_cur_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1
    t = t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_0]
    __idx_tripcount_stack_1_2 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + 1
    cur = tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_2]
    for i = cur:-1:1
        tb = tb + t * yb[i]
        tb = tb + t * yb[i]
        __idx_t_stack_1_0 = prefix_t_stack_1[(i_l - 1) + 1] + ((i - 1) + 1)
        t = t_stack[__idx_t_stack_1_0]
        CUDA.@atomic xb[i] += x[i] * tb
        CUDA.@atomic xb[i] += x[i] * tb
        tb = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end
